mapper.select: SELECT w.drafting_work_category_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(g.cata_name), ''), '기타문서') AS category_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(w.code_name), ''), '-') AS division_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(w.reg_term), ''), '발생시') AS reg_term, '관리자 외 2명' AS assignee_summary FROM tb_drafting_work_category w JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = w.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_drafting_work_category_group g ON g.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND g.drafting_work_category_group_id = w.drafting_work_category_group_id WHERE w.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND COALESCE(w.delete_status, 'N') != 'Y' AND COALESCE(w.use_at, 'N') = 'Y' ORDER BY CASE WHEN COALESCE(TRIM(g.view_seq::varchar), '') ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(TRIM(g.view_seq::varchar) AS integer) ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN COALESCE(TRIM(w.view_seq::varchar), '') ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(TRIM(w.view_seq::varchar) AS integer) ELSE 0 END, w.drafting_work_category_id
